description: X accounts ranked by standing (how much other accounts engage with them) or, with metric, by their track record as callers.. Standing measures attention, not accuracy; track is null for an account that has never opened a position. For the best callers use metric=alphaScore, not avgReturn, which a few big wins or a rally can top. Track metrics rank only accounts with at least 20 scored positions, over every position since late June 2026; scoredEpisodes is the number of positions behind each account's track metrics.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous reply. Change any argument but limit and it fails; start again without it.

limit.description: Items per page, up to 200. Keep it small and page with cursor rather than asking for everything at once.

metric.description: standing (default). alphaScore: return against the market (BTC for crypto, SPY for equities) and outright. hitRate: share of scored positions that made money. avgReturn: mean realized return, not adjusted for the market.
